justification: Removes the flaky magic-link login from /internal/leads and replaces it with a simple shared access key (INTERNAL_ACCESS_KEY via ?key=). The page holds customer PII, so it is deliberately NOT made fully public: the gate is fail-closed — if the env key is unset or the query key is wrong, the page returns notFound() and never renders the leads. One file; no change to the lead data path or the verdict engine.
functions: N/A - swaps the auth guard at the top of the page component; no function added or changed in signature beyond adding the searchParams prop.
values: N/A - reads one env var (INTERNAL_ACCESS_KEY) and one query param (key); no DB or external-API values drive a decision.
queries: N/A - the existing lead SELECT is unchanged.

break_it.scenario: INTERNAL_ACCESS_KEY is not set in the environment (e.g. forgotten in Vercel) and someone opens /internal/leads.
break_it.what_happens: With no key configured the page must not fall open and leak PII.
break_it.how: The gate is fail-closed: `if (!required || key !== required) notFound()` — an unset env var means `required` is falsy, so every request 404s and the leads never render. The old behaviour (open when a flag was unset) is gone.
break_it.repro: Unset INTERNAL_ACCESS_KEY, visit /internal/leads and /internal/leads?key=anything, and confirm both 404 with no lead data in the response.

break_it.scenario: Someone guesses the /internal/leads URL but does not know the access key.
break_it.what_happens: Without the key they must not see any lead PII.
break_it.how: The query key must exactly equal INTERNAL_ACCESS_KEY; any mismatch calls notFound() before the admin client is created or any lead is fetched. The page is also noindex.
break_it.repro: With INTERNAL_ACCESS_KEY set, visit /internal/leads without ?key and with a wrong ?key; confirm both 404, and the correct ?key renders the table.

break_it.scenario: The access key, being in the URL, leaks via browser history, referrer headers, or server logs.
break_it.what_happens: A leaked key would let a holder read the leads until the key is rotated.
break_it.how: Accepted trade-off for a single-user internal tool that was previously blocked by broken magic-link auth; the key is a rotatable secret (change the env var to invalidate), the page is noindex, and it exposes read-only lead data, not account control. A cookie/session upgrade is a follow-up if the tool gains more users.
break_it.repro: Rotate INTERNAL_ACCESS_KEY in the env and confirm the old ?key value now 404s.

post_merge.db_reset: Not required - no schema or data change.
post_merge.secrets: Add INTERNAL_ACCESS_KEY (a long random string) to the Vercel project env. Then open /internal/leads?key=<that value> and bookmark it — no login needed. Leave it unset and the page stays 404 (safe default).
post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - after setting INTERNAL_ACCESS_KEY on the deploy: confirm /internal/leads?key=<value> shows the leads table, and that /internal/leads (no key) and a wrong key both 404.
